name: 74012 · Broken Arrow, OK
findings: ZIP 74012 (Broken Arrow) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74012 (Broken Arrow) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
